long_biography.plain_text:
Consolidating the Dubrovnik Three Sisters site has become Vicenco Blagaić's defining long-term undertaking. Starting in 2007, the Split businessman pursued a coastal tract divided among 103 families and their heirs. More than sixteen years and roughly 1,200 contracts were needed to assemble the principal parcel and move the development beyond its planning phase.

Blagaić chose to retain control of the scheme rather than sell it outright. Under his direction, the privately owned project secured planning approvals and began infrastructure works, while architects developed hotels, branded residences, villas and public spaces. He remains director of its project company and manager of the holding and property vehicles that own and develop the site.
